rationale: The 512-dimensional projected SIGReg endpoint has low target participation rank and is worse than forecast-only. Local LeJEPA's successful minimal example uses a 16-dimensional output projector. Isolate dimensionality after the paired placement experiment; do not infer temporal incompatibility from an oversized target.
treatment: anchored-projected-small: D512 -> D512 GELU -> 16 target projector, matching 16-dimensional predictor outputs, 16-dimensional random-sphere SIGReg directions
comparison: existing anchored-projected D512-target endpoint; identical weights, hidden widths, observed-bar horizons, forecast backbone/head, population masks and training protocol; no new no-SIGReg run because that control already demonstrates auxiliary collapse
diagnostics: same authenticated population/gradient packet; observation directions remain D512, target directions D16 with same declared seed and null expectation; distinct dimensions explicitly recorded
selection: predefined seven-horizon actual-close MSE/persistence with directional, IC, per-horizon and calibration tradeoffs; Gaussianity and latent predictability are explanatory only
